notes.title: Happy International Cat Day, cat lovers!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40124497/59d949b81559569d87c51c29ac2052b40470496e.jpg[/img]

🐾 Happy International Cat Day, cat lovers!

Today, we’re not just celebrating the cats in our games, but also our own furry babies! 🐱💛
From the playful mischief makers to the professional nap champions, our Nukearts team cats are here to say hi!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40124497/9a324c520b758ecbd7519468baf0ab5e54d14e45.jpg[/img]

Meet some of our beloved kitties who inspire the cozy adventures of the Hidden Cats series everyday. Who knows, maybe you’ve spotted a few of them hiding in the games? 👀

From the romantic rooftops of Paris to the scary corners of Spooky Town, the snowy magic of Santa’s Realm to the bustling streets of Tokyo and Rio de Janeiro… we’ve been all over the world searching for cats, and we’re not stopping!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40124497/1a1984d54fdd61ef62de08bfd1761ab9f3bf6957.jpg[/img]

🐈 Our next stop is almost here:
Wishlist Hidden Cats in Istanbul on Steam and come join our cozy community on Discord:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2906270/Hidden_Cats_in_Istanbul/

Your turn now! Drop your cat’s name in the comments so we can celebrate together!

notes.title: New Content Update
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce that now Hidden Cats in Paris, our very first from the series, now have more fun stuff for you! The game now has more fit with its brothers London and New York!

Additional Content:

[list]

[*] Advanced Mode: 150 cats + special cats + characters

[/list]

Enjoy the game and give us your feedback!

[i]* tier price will change to  $2 USD soon.[/i]

notes.title: Hidden Cats in New York + Paris Update
notes.notes:
Our release of Hidden Cats in London was awesome. Thanks to you all, we had a lot of feedback that allowed us to polish the game and get new ideas for new Hidden Objects projects.

[h1]Hidden Cats in London[/h1]
Small updates are on the way to polish a few things.

[h1]Hidden Cats in New York[/h1]
Our next Hidden Cats game is under production with even more contents. Expect it this Q1 of 2023. Add it to your wishlist and follow us to be aware of news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260530/Hidden_Cats_in_New_York/

[h1]Hidden Cats in Paris[/h1]
Many people asked for more, and we are working to put Paris on the same level as London in terms of content and price. More information we'll be given on the game page as soon as we have more to share. You can expect the update release on this Q1 of 2023.

Those are just the first news that we can share with you, but more Hidden Cats games will come this year! We wish you all an amazing 2023!
